responsibility: Machine-description file for ARC SIMD and related packed/DSP vector instructions. It introduces SIMD unspec codes, scheduler reservations for SIMD instruction classes, vector move/load/store patterns, builtin-backed vector arithmetic/logic/permute/control instructions, accumulator-using MAC operations, and some emulated vector expanders, forming the RTL and scheduling side of ARC SIMD support that matches builtins.def and arc-simd.h.
